description: Set X Leads Discovery public-attention settings on an account (main or pool): poster, surface, post goal, quote target, like/public-after-DM toggles, pool fallback, per-run limit, and the account's daily post/like caps (superset of set_x_account_daily_limits). Only fields you pass change; everything else keeps its current account/workspace/env value.

x_followup_max_per_thread.description: Max automated reply rounds in one public thread before going quiet. Not a daily cap — per-thread, and not account-only.

x_ld_like_daily_limit.description: Max engagement likes this account may send per day (0-2000).

x_ld_public_daily_limit.description: Max public quotes/replies this account may post per day (0-500).

x_ld_public_only.description: Cold LD import: public quote/reply only, no DMs.

name: admin__set_x_account_attention
